description: Lists the consulting and development services offered by Huntay AzerTürk, with links. If need is given (the user's problem or project in their own words), services are ranked by fit and each includes the matching item from its service page. Use when the user asks which of Huntay AzerTürk's services exist or fit their project.

need.description: Optional: the user's need or project, e.g. "answer customer questions on WhatsApp".

name: list_services
title: List services
